subject.title: feat: add Zed Remote Projects handoff

question: Should Crabbox add a permanent top-level `crabbox zed` command for this editor-specific handoff, or keep the workflow on generic SSH and documentation surfaces?
rationale: The implementation is additive and bounded, but a dedicated editor command establishes a lasting CLI-product precedent that code review alone cannot decide.

options.title: Sponsor the Zed command
options.body: Accept the dedicated handoff because it removes a multi-step workflow while reusing provider-neutral SSH and lease-activity primitives.

options.title: Keep the CLI generic
options.body: Document the workflow around synchronization and `crabbox ssh` without adding an editor-specific top-level command.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the Zed command
recommendation.body: Accept the dedicated handoff because it removes a multi-step workflow while reusing provider-neutral SSH and lease-activity primitives.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history most strongly connects this person to the adjacent CLI, SSH, and interactive Code access surfaces.
